title: ExtremeMobs
description:
Makes Hostile Mob's in Minecraft Way Harder...
And adds custom abilities to the Hostile Mobs.
body:
This plugin makes Hostile Mob's harder to beat. For example it gives all hostile mob's 4x the amount of health and of course you can edit all of this in the config and adjust it to how you like it, since this plugin is still in development and not fully ready only some mobs have custom features.

List of Mob's which have custome features
: Zombie ( it has a chance to get fire resis when spawned, it has chance to blow up like tnt when killed and finnaly a chance to spawn water which dissapear's in a few second's but it s configurable
